about: Findings of tools/game_audit.py that are known and accepted. Each entry needs a reason; matched findings are still counted and listed in the report under 'Allowed', never hidden. Fields: code (or '*'), area (substring of the area name or key), level (number or 'A-B,C'), key (regex on the decor or creature key), x, y, reason.
